description: This file defines a generic DirectoryCache class in TypeScript for caching directory entries, with features such as cache expiration, size limit, and cache invalidation based on configuration changes. It also includes utilities for generating cache keys.

classes.name: DirectoryCache
classes.description: A generic in-memory cache implementation for directory entries, parameterized by type T, with TTL, maximum size, and configuration change handling.
